approaches.name: integrated government management information systems with predictive analytics and data lake
approaches.description: Deploys integrated asset, payroll, pension, investment and procurement systems plus a state data lake and predictive analytics to centralize and audit government data. Practices: Integrated asset management system with comprehensive inventory; Predictive analytics and automated auditing of state payroll; Integrated pension management system interoperable with HR system; Predictive actuarial analytics tool for pension liabilities; Automated auditing of pension and retirement payroll; Integrated public investment project management system; Geolocation tools for monitoring state real estate assets; Government data lake centralizing and de-duplicating agency data; Automated IFR reporting via i-Gesp integration with SGI and target platform; State data lake integrating agencies for whole-of-government management; Pension management system SISPREV integrated with HRMIS and FMIS; Management analytics product on audit data flagging payroll nonconformity risk areas for control; State data lake integrating agency systems; New e-GP tool with management dashboards; People analytics on gender-disaggregated HR and pension data; AI pilots detecting fraud in public procurement.
